title: A Lovely Evening in Barcelona
text: Thank you so much, India, for showing us around and teaching us all about tapas and pinchos in the local neighborhood. We were delighted to discover Barcelona during this four-hour tour through the Gothic Quarter, ending with a visit to the Sagrada Familia. Clara was such a pleasure to talk to throughout the evening.
author: 380indieb

title: What a delicious tour!!
text: Nuria was so warm and welcoming. We visited  lovely local tapas spots during the four-hour tour. The wine and food were exactly what we had hoped to enjoy. Nuria recommended great wines and the best dishes at each location. The conversation was just as enjoyable as the food and drinks, and the visit to Sagrada Familia was a lovely finish. I absolutely recommend it!
author: 469cleom

title: A Fabulous and Delicious Time in Barcelona
text: This was a wonderful experience, walking around and being taught about the spectacular structures and history of this Barcelona area. Simône was an excellent tour guide and really knew how to make delicious tapas choices and wine for our enjoyment. We highly recommend this excursion!
author: Susan_L

title: A delicious tapas experience
text: We had such a great time with Diego! He was really helpful getting us to the meeting point and even helping us get back to the hotel after the tour. He took us to three different tapas bars, and we thoroughly enjoyed trying the tapas and drinks at each place before finishing with the Sagrada Familia. He shared lots of interesting knowledge about the area and made us feel completely comfortable throughout the experience.
author: saffronr737

title: A very fun and interesting tour
text: Our evening with Lucia was fantastic! She is so friendly, welcoming, and knowledgeable. we felt like locals for the day because she brought us to places we never would have discovered on our own. The pinchos were creative and delicious, and the drinks were really good. We ended up completely full and a little tipsy!!! Amazing.
author: 790zariak

title: A lovely food experience
text: Clara was very enthusiastic and friendly and selected some excellent food and drinks for us. The vermouth was a very pleasant surprise. She also gave us some great insights into Spanish and Catalan lifestyles. Thoroughly recommended.
author: florianhT4304RC

title: Amazing tour
text: Isabel was exactly what we needed on our first evening in Barcelona. We’re traveling through Spain and felt that having a local take us to some of their favorite places was far better than figuring it out as we went. Isabel gave us a fantastic night, amazing food and drinks in quieter neighborhoods, great conversation, and plenty of laughs.
author: tychov798

title: Barcelona’s best flavors
text: Isabel was fantastic! She adjusted our tapas tour and also include some history since we only had one day in Barcelona. She kept our two teenagers engaged while we discovered the city’s past and sampled lots of delicious dishes. I would absolutely recommend her!
author: J235KLmirkoc

title: Book Without Thinking Twice
text: Marco was an outstanding host. He possesses the uncommon capacity to be both friendly and informed while additionally sensing exactly how much detail guests want shared. Besides, the food was very good, we got to eat incredible dishes
author: dominicsT5706PV

title: A Feast for the Senses in Barcelona
text: What an incredible experience! I can’t even call it just a tour — it was a full sensory journey through Barcelona. Diego went above and beyond, guiding us through the Gothic Quarter’s charming streets and treating us to unforgettable flavors at every stop. From Iberian ham at La Boquería to pinxos, tapas with cava, and the creamiest crema catalana, everything was perfection. We ended the day with churros and hot chocolate before skipping the line at the breathtaking Sagrada Familia. An absolute must when in Barcelona!
author: R891RZmanonl
